title: A small, optical improvement suggestion.
body:
A small optical improvement suggestion.

The abbreviations for days and hours in German (or English) confuse me every time and our 8 year old son does not quite understand it either😉.
d - Day
s - hours or Stunden??

t. and std. or d. and h. would be, I think, more understandable.

Thanks for your great work!!!


![Screenshot_20230105-141756](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/92778761/210793179-c6b76fe3-ea2e-4a73-8ab2-e2f70e252684.png)

comments.body: it must be done through translation

Changing it within translations will cause other issues like #1960. I think there's not an optimal solution for german translation at this point. One option is PR #1968 which I really like and use myself - however, it's not optimal for dash users.
